gaps: Absent metric series/buckets are bounded non-observations through the final metric request; no permanent-absence or global ingestion-latency guarantee. No deliberately failing endpoint or InvalidAttributes case was manufactured.
notes: No PutMetricData, alarms, Lambda, CloudTrail or other infrastructure. Topic default policy unchanged; each SQS policy authorizes only the exact owned topic ARN.

Filter policy and scope supplied atomically at Subscribe. Documentation allows up to 15 minutes propagation; actual receipts and filter metrics determine observed activation, not configured attributes alone.
Counter SampleCount/Minimum/Maximum queried to distinguish minute aggregates from per-event samples; published documentation recommends Sum.
Message component sizes are calculated from original UTF-8 input, not delivered JSON envelope or AWS CLI JSON serialization. All attributes in this probe use String.

Native samples exclude Subject from PublishSize: single input components body31 each/subject6 on two/attributes31 on one produced Sum124, SampleCount3, Minimum31, Maximum62. Batch body33+34 and attributes14+14 produced one 95-byte sample despite a 4-byte Subject.

Native NumberOfNotificationsFilteredOut sums only ordinary attribute/body mismatches here; NoMessageAttributes and InvalidMessageBody appeared as separate reason counters without incrementing that general counter.

Original comparison window is 2026-09-14T12:08:00Z through 12:12:00Z (three workload minutes plus full idle minute). Supplemental admission boundary is 12:15:00Z and must not be included in original workload totals.

The script generated the original capture; the supplemental boundary was executed through Eval using the same aws_cli.result decoder and merged after cleanup. Original observations and original receipt counts were not rewritten.
